_hinweis: FALLBACK only: since round 7 produkte.json from Unity brings typ and anzeigename for every product – these win. Used from here: masse, and kategorie/nummer/klasse only if produkte.json leaves typ/anzeigename empty (the build script then lists it). Additional product info that produkte.json from Unity does not contain (yet). Key = product name exactly as in produkte.json. kategorie: tables | seating | storage | lighting. Values in produkte.json win if they exist there. nummer is optional (otherwise taken from the name), klasse (S | M | L) only if produkte.json has none. The display name is OBJ_<type>_<size>_<number>, e.g. OBJ_TB_M_01; the type abbreviations are set in _typen.
